gpu_request.rule: GPUs only in limits; requests optional but must equal limits; requests without limits not allowed

GKE.condition: only if cluster has at least one non-GPU node pool
GKE.toleration: added automatically by ExtendedResourceToleration admission controller

AKS.note: documented convention via --node-taints at node pool creation; AKS-managed GPU node pools install driver+device plugin+DCGM exporter; --gpu-driver none to skip driver (replaces retired --skip-gpu-driver-install tag, retired 2025-08-14)

EKS_Auto_Mode.note: set in user's Karpenter NodePool example; Auto Mode ships NVIDIA drivers and device plugin (not visible as DaemonSet); pod toleration operator Exists

k3s.auto_detect: K3s adds nvidia/nvidia-cdi/nvidia-experimental runtimes to containerd if found in PATH at start
k3s.runtimeclass: runtimeClassName: nvidia in pod spec, or --default-runtime
k3s.device_plugin: used together with NVIDIA device plugin; example requests nvidia.com/gpu: 1
